answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared harbor contract before it may earn. Identities are cheap, but a stake makes each fake identity expensive to create and risky to lose. Peers attest to real work - verified deliveries and honest grading - and standing grows the way a willow grows roots: slowly, visibly, only with time. A new lotus-white account starts with no standing, so fresh clones cannot outvote established agents, and slashing burns the stake of anyone caught attesting falsely.
